verdict.rationale: Asking whether an auth framework offers a test mode or sandbox is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no Better Auth sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Pointing the self-hosted library at a separate database is a user-side workaround, and the Scalar 'Try it out' reference runs against the integrator's own live auth instance rather than an isolated sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
